sentences.text:
Opposite Parties
 Mr. M.K. Mohanty, Addl.PP
 Mr. S. Sethi, Advocate (Op-2)
 Coram:

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is an application U/S.439 of CrPC by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with T.R.
Case No.187 of 2023 arising out of Nachuni P.S. Case No.74 of 2023 pending in the file of learned Special Judge (POCSO)-cum-Addl. Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar for commission of offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n)/376(AB) of the IPC r/w. Section 6 of POCSO Act, on the allegation of committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon the victim aged about 12 years.

3. Heard, Mr. Manoranjan Padhy, learned counsel for the petitioner, Mr. Santosh Sethi, learned counsel for the informant-victim and Mr. M.K. Mohanty, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record.
4.

After having considered the rival submission and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offence as alleged against the petitioner and on going through the evidence of the victim as produced by the petitioner, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
Hence, the bail application of the petitioner stands rejected.
Trial be expedited in view of the requests made by learned counsel for the petitioner.
5. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
